title: Bounded native Ensorain experiment + RESULT (s10)
objective: Run the frozen experiment; outcome decided by the registered criteria; self-contained RESULT.
problem: Local CPU on harry1, ONE process (all arms one host and version set), not ubu006. Execute exactly PREREGISTRATION v1.1.0 s10: `python -B -m rso.ensorain.freeze check` (must print OK) then `python -B -m rso.ensorain.assay confirm rso/ensorain/runs/CONFIRM.json --n 400 --subjects rso/ensorain/SUBJECTS.json --cleared-by "C-016-T042 integrated (Palamedes, merge dfaf48d07; REPORT rso/ensorain/challenge/R2/REPORT.md)"`. If one call would exceed 600 s, read assay.py for a resumable/sliced mode; if there is none, run it in the foreground with timeout 600000 and, if it times out, record that and STOP (escalate) -- do not change code. Read the output ONLY under PREREGISTRATION s5 and REPORT R2 s4. RESULT.md MUST: (1) state qualification Q-a..Q-e first -- if any fails the run is DETECTION_UNQUALIFIED and no subject verdict is read; (2) give the family-P (reference) verdict with K1f/K1n/K2 W:L:T, Holm p, revised lives per arm, noswitch; (3) report search accessibility as REPORT R2 L2 requires: 1 testable subject (searched_16310006) and 7 not (5 no plastic key, 2 dead plastic: 007, 008), 006 read at the alpha/6 family-S worst case, with its per-arm numbers and noswitch beside its label; (4) carry L1 verbatim in meaning: a K1-only label (REVISION_NOT_HISTORY_DEPENDENT or REVISION_WITHOUT_RETAINED_COMPETENCE) does NOT license 'revises' -- it covers law-blind drift (walker) and halt-on-success search; only REVISION_HISTORY_DEPENDENT excludes drift; (5) carry L3 (absolute eta floor; false negatives only), L4 (G_R5 meaning), L5 (no drift control registered), O1 (the bound is part of the mechanism); (6) restate the scope: revision of a genome-initialised or lifetime-learned plastic parameter; NOT 'learned in life'; NOT retention (no tested Ensorain world demands retention -- a finding); (7) resources: CPU-s, wall, memory, rows_sha256. Commit rows + RESULT.md. No re-run with other seeds, no subject selection, no world change.
non_goals: No edit to ensorain/ or roles/Ensorain/ (frozen WTP-05 code, seeds, runs)
No selection after inspecting the final ruler
No edit in another seat's lane
